dict.string: The Now Playing widget uses this to show and control what Apple Music or Spotify is playing. Programs you run in a GRID terminal can also ask to control other apps.
Websites you allow in GRID’s browser can use the camera (for example, video calls).
A program running in a GRID terminal or file browser wants to access your Desktop folder.
A program running in a GRID terminal or file browser wants to access your Documents folder.
A program running in a GRID terminal or file browser wants to access your Downloads folder.
GRID’s Map shows where you are when you click Locate. Your location stays on this Mac.
